description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" compares the performance of different model variants in terms of recall and F1-score metrics. The x-axis represents the model variants, which include "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The x-axis is labeled with the model variants and is categorical, with no numerical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and represents the percentage values for recall and F1-score, with a linear scale ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. The recall metric is depicted by a solid line with circle markers, while the F1-score is represented by a dashed line with circle markers. The recall line starts at 65.78% for the "Full model (Ours)" variant, dips to 59.64% for "w/o Prompt," peaks at 63.75% for "w/o Augmentation," drops to 59.17% for "w/o Attention," and further decreases to 56.82% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The F1-score line begins at 65.45% for the "Full model (Ours)" variant, decreases to 61.06% for "w/o Prompt," increases to 62.22% for "w/o Augmentation," rises to 64.06% for "w/o Attention," and then falls to 57.74% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." Data points are annotated with their respective values above each marker, providing a clear and precise reference for the metrics at each model variant.
